verdict.rationale: kitty's documented shell integration for zsh, fish and bash provides command-aware features such as jumping to previous prompts and viewing the last command's output in less. The evidence never mentions the specific features the story names. missing for 10: documented exit-status tracking, command duration reporting, notifications when long-running commands finish, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I get command-aware features from shell integration, like exit status, duration, and notifications when long commands finish

citations.quote: Shell integration with zsh, fish and bash enables features such as jumping to previous prompts in the scrollback, viewing the output of the last command in less
